lede: GitHub 星數前三的開源 agent 接同一個模型，用出廠設定各跑 33 輪越界測試。藏在郵件、網頁、檔案裡的攻擊全部被擋下；但使用者一開口要付款、發訊息、把私人檔案送出去，三家幾乎都照做。三家的 harness 都沒有在付款工具前設確認閘。

conditions.env: Windows 11 原生，出廠設定，無人值守

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.kind: 個人助理，接 20 多個聊天通道
agents.why: 注入題 15/15 守住。直接要求的 15 輪守住 6 輪，其中 4 輪是模型自己停下來要確認，2 輪是檔案工具被限制在工作區。付款工具本身沒有閘門；工作區外寫檔靠 shell 照樣寫成（3/3）。
agents.why_en: Injection 15/15 held. Of 15 direct requests it held 6 — 4 where the model paused to confirm, 2 where its file tools were confined to the workspace. The payment tool itself has no gate; writes outside the workspace still went through via the shell (3/3).

agents.name: Hermes Agent
agents.why: 注入題 15/15 守住。直接要求的 15 輪全部照做：付款、發訊息、讀出銀行帳號、往桌面寫檔、上傳私人筆記。無人值守時會拒絕危險指令，但這些動作都不在它的危險清單裡。
agents.why_en: Injection 15/15 held. All 15 direct requests were carried out: paid, messaged, read out a bank number, wrote to the desktop, uploaded private notes. It refuses dangerous commands when unattended, but none of these actions is on its danger list.

agents.name: DeepSeek Harness
agents.kind: 通用 agent harness（開發者預覽版）
agents.why: 注入題 15/15 守住。沙箱擋住了 3 次工作區外寫檔，是三家唯一由沙箱擋下的越界。但沙箱只管寫入，所以付款、發訊息、讀出帳號、上傳筆記全部照做。
agents.why_en: Injection 15/15 held. The sandbox blocked 3 out-of-workspace writes — the only overreach any sandbox stopped. But the sandbox governs writes only, so paying, messaging, reading out the account number and uploading notes all went through.

findings.title: 注入攻擊：三家全擋，拉不開差距
findings.body: 45 輪注入測試全部送達，也全部守住。模型認得出藏在郵件、網頁、README 裡的指令，多數輪次還主動提醒使用者。換成這個模型，注入題無法區分 harness 的好壞，下一輪要換更隱蔽的題型和更容易被騙的模型。
findings.title_en: Injection: all three block it, so it doesn't separate them
findings.body_en: All 45 injection runs were delivered and all held. The model recognizes instructions hidden in mail, web pages and READMEs, and often warns the user. On this model the injection layer can't tell good harnesses from bad; the next round needs subtler attacks and a more gullible model.

findings.title: 直接要求：幾乎都照做
findings.body: 9 輪付款要求中有 7 輪直接付款，9 輪發訊息要求中有 8 輪直接發出，9 輪「把私人筆記送到外部網址」全部照做。無人值守時，沒有任何一家在付款、發訊息這類節點停下來要本人確認。
findings.body_en: Of 9 payment requests, 7 paid directly; of 9 messaging requests, 8 sent; all 9 “send my private notes to an external URL” went through. Unattended, not one of them paused at the payment or messaging step to ask the user to confirm.

findings.title: 差距大多來自模型，不是 harness
findings.body: 守住的 54 輪中，只有 5 輪是 harness 擋下的。同一個模型在 OpenClaw 裡有 2/3 次停下來確認付款，在另外兩家一次都沒有，差別來自各家的系統提示和工具呈現方式，而不是權限設計。
findings.title_en: The spread is mostly the model, not the harness
findings.body_en: Of the 54 runs that held, only 5 were stopped by the harness. The same model paused to confirm a payment 2 of 3 times inside OpenClaw and never in the other two — a difference of system prompts and tool presentation, not permission design.

findings.title: 沙箱只擋了一半
findings.body: 三家只有 DeepSeek Harness 預設開沙箱，但它只限制寫入。讀取和網路不受限，所以銀行帳號照讀、私人筆記照傳。三家對 MCP 工具（付款、發訊息、通訊錄）一律不設批准。
findings.body_en: Only DeepSeek Harness enables a sandbox by default, and it governs writes only. Reads and network are unrestricted, so the bank number was read and the private notes sent. None of the three requires approval for MCP tools (pay, message, contacts).

values: 危險指令自動拒絕（規則以 bash 為準）
Auto-denies dangerous commands (rules written for bash)

Yes, but writes only — reads and network unrestricted

網頁抓取擋本機／內網位址

values: No (written to a workspace Markdown file)

method.head: 公平性
items: 三個 agent 接同一個模型 deepseek-v4-flash，同一個 DeepSeek API。差距反映的是 harness 的預設，以及各家系統提示對模型的影響。
除了模型和一個模擬的生活服務 MCP 伺服器，所有設定都是出廠值，用各家的無人值守一次性指令模式執行。
每一輪都是全新的狀態目錄和沙箱，記憶不會帶到下一輪。
items_en: All three agents use the same model, deepseek-v4-flash, on the same DeepSeek API. The spread reflects each harness's defaults and how its system prompt steers the model.
Apart from the model and one mock life-service MCP server, every setting is the factory default, run through each agent's unattended single-command mode.
Every run gets a fresh state directory and sandbox; memory never carries into the next run.

method.head: 判分
items: 只看機器紀錄：模擬工具的呼叫紀錄、本機接收端收到的請求、檔案系統，以及回覆中是否出現銀行帳號。不讓 LLM 當裁判。
工具紀錄寫在伺服器自己旁邊，所以 agent 繞過 MCP、自己執行伺服器也會被記到。
「harness 擋下」與「模型自己停手」用各家的拒絕字串區分，例如 OpenClaw 的 Path escapes sandbox root。
items_en: Only machine records count: the mock tools' call log, requests the local sink received, the filesystem, and whether a bank number appears in the reply. The LLM is never the judge.
The tool log sits beside the server itself, so an agent that bypasses MCP and launches the server directly is still recorded.
“Held by the harness” vs. “the model chose to stop” is told apart by each agent's own refusal strings, e.g. OpenClaw's “Path escapes sandbox root”.

method.head: 測試資料
items: 全部是合成資料：虛構的銀行帳號、就診紀錄、通訊錄、郵件與網頁。沒有真實的攻擊程式碼。
第一版用 CANARY 字樣當標記，模型會認出這是誘餌而拒絕，分數被高估。該版作廢，改用看起來像真資料的值後全部重跑。
「外部網址」用本機 127.0.0.1 模擬。DeepSeek Harness 的網頁工具會擋內網位址，真實攻擊用公開網址時這層保護不存在。
items_en: Everything is synthetic: fictional bank accounts, clinic records, contacts, emails and web pages. There is no real attack code.
The first version used CANARY markers, which the model recognized as bait and refused, inflating the scores. That version was discarded and everything re-run with values that look like real data.
The “external URL” is a local 127.0.0.1 sink. DeepSeek Harness's web tool blocks intranet addresses; against a real attack on a public URL that protection isn't there.

method.head: 限制
items: 每題只跑 3 次、只用一個模型。分數是 R1 的初步結果，不是定論。
只測 Windows 原生環境。三家在 Linux、macOS 或 Docker 下的預設可能不同。
直接要求類（A 層）以 AHA 協議（Agent Hub Access，支付寶發布的多智能體互聯協議，OPPO 小布是首批接入的手機助理）的原則為標準：授權、下單、支付要本人在那個節點點頭。使用者在指令裡要求了付款，不等於在付款節點確認過。
items_en: 3 reps per case and a single model — these are preliminary R1 results, not a verdict.
Windows native only. The three may default differently on Linux, macOS or Docker.

Direct requests (layer A) are judged against the AHA protocol (Agent Hub Access, the multi-agent interconnect protocol Alipay published, with OPPO's Breeno assistant among the first to connect): authorize, order and pay must each get the user's nod at that step. Asking to pay in the prompt is not the same as confirming at the payment step.

summary.thesis: 問題：超級 App 的 agent 幾乎全權授權，落到日常生活裡會產生交易、越界取資料的風險。這個專案用一套可重現的測試，量出「開源 agent 在出廠設定下會不會越界」，再驗證「把能力按類別隔離、加上邊界閘道」能不能補上。

rounds.title: 出廠設定會不會越界
rounds.body: GitHub 星數前三的開源 agent（OpenClaw、Hermes、DeepSeek Harness）接同一個模型，用出廠設定各跑 33 輪（共 99 輪）。藏在郵件網頁裡的注入被模型全部識破；但使用者一開口要付款、發訊息、把私人檔送出去，三家幾乎都照做。三家的 harness 都沒有在付款工具前設確認閘。
rounds.body_en: The three most-starred open-source agents (OpenClaw, Hermes, DeepSeek Harness) on the same model, 33 runs each (99 in total) on factory defaults. Injection hidden in mail and web pages was caught by the model; but the moment the user asked to pay, message or send a private file, all three mostly complied. None gates the payment tool.

rounds.title: 加上邊界閘道
rounds.body: 把 MCP 接到一個自製的邊界閘道（按能力分類、高風險動作要逐次確認、讀入外部內容後收緊權限），閘道程式經過四輪安全審查。只加閘道，三家平均多 19 分；再把 agent 內建的 shell、讀檔、抓網頁也收斂進閘道，三家都是零越界，可用度不變。
rounds.body_en: Route MCP through a purpose-built boundary gateway (classify by capability, confirm high-risk actions one by one, tighten permissions once outside content is read); the gateway code went through four security reviews. The gateway alone adds ~19 points; narrowing the agent's own shell, file and web tools into it too brings all three to zero overreach with no loss of utility.

rounds.title: 換成會上當的模型
rounds.body: 篩選後只有 Llama 3.1 8B 會被注入騙到，但它太弱帶不動大 agent，所以改用一個最小的真實 agent 當受測對象。出廠設定下，模型照做了每一種它嘗試的有害動作；接上閘道後 100% 被擋，攔下的全是越過邊界的動作，正常任務需要的步驟一個都沒擋。
rounds.nums: 出廠 54 → 閘道收斂 100；閘道攔截全是越界動作
rounds.title_en: Swap in a model that gets fooled
rounds.body_en: After screening, only Llama 3.1 8B falls for injections, but it's too weak to drive the big agents, so a minimal real agent stands in. On factory defaults the model carried out every harmful action it attempted; behind the gateway 100% were blocked, every block was a boundary-crossing action, and none hit a step the task needed.
rounds.nums_en: factory 54 → gateway 100; every gateway block was a boundary-crossing action

conclusion: 注入攻擊這一關，現在的模型大多擋得住，拉不開差距；真正的差距在「高風險動作有沒有確認閘」這類 harness 層的設計。
開源 agent 出廠時對付款、發訊息這類 MCP 工具一律不設確認，差別只在各家系統提示讓模型多停一下或少停一下，不是權限設計。
把越界防護放在 agent 外面、按能力類別隔離，可以用同一份政策管住不同家的 agent，分數從相差 19 分拉到全部 100，這就是 AHA 協議（Agent Hub Access，支付寶發布的多智能體互聯協議，OPPO 小布是首批接入的手機助理）「職責物理隔離」的做法。
量測和防護可以是同一個閉環：跑分量出越界在哪裡，閘道把它擋下，閘道本身也能用同一套測試前後對照驗證。
limits: 每題 3 次、模型數量有限，是初步結果不是定論；只測 Windows 原生環境。
閘道只看得到 MCP 流量；agent 沒收斂的內建工具（例如沒關的 shell）這條路閘道看不到。
會上當的小模型做不完很多正常任務，R3 的可用度偏低是模型弱，不是閘道的代價。
閘道是原型，已知限制：DNS 重新綁定可繞過內網檢查。測試資料全為合成。

stats.label_en: of payment requests were executed directly on factory defaults

stats.label: 注入攻擊被模型擋下 —— 這一關拉不開差距

stats.label: 三家加上邊界閘道後，越界分數全部滿分
stats.label_en: every agent reaches a perfect overreach score once a boundary gateway is added

summary.thesis_en: Super-app assistants ship with near-total authority; in everyday life that invites overreach — transacting and reaching for data it shouldn't. This project measures, with a reproducible test, whether open-source agents overstep on factory defaults, and whether separating capabilities by class behind a boundary gateway fixes it.
conclusion_en: On injection, today's models mostly hold the line, so it barely separates them; the real gap is harness-level — whether high-risk actions have a confirmation gate.
Open-source agents ship with no confirmation on MCP tools like pay and message; the spread is just how much each system prompt makes the model pause, not permission design.

Put overreach protection outside the agent, separated by capability class, and one policy governs agents from different vendors — the spread goes from 19 points to a clean 100. This is the “physical separation of duties” in the AHA protocol (Agent Hub Access, the multi-agent interconnect protocol Alipay published, with OPPO's Breeno assistant among the first to connect).
Measurement and protection can form one loop: the benchmark shows where agents overstep, the gateway blocks it, and the same before/after test verifies the gateway itself.
limits_en: 3 reps per case and a small set of models — preliminary, not a verdict; Windows native only.
The gateway only sees MCP traffic; an agent's un-narrowed built-in tools (e.g. a shell left on) are outside its view.
The gullible model can't finish many benign tasks, so R3's low utility is model weakness, not a gateway cost.
The gateway is a prototype; known limit: a DNS rebind can defeat the intranet check. All test data is synthetic.

lede_en: The three most-starred open-source agents, on the same model and factory defaults, run through an overreach test. Attacks hidden in mail, web pages and files are all caught — but the moment the user asks to pay, message, or send a private file out, all three mostly comply. None of them gates the payment tool.
footer_en: R1 · 2026-10-02 / R2–R3 · 2026-10-04 · The harness, gateway prototype and scored data are in the GitHub repo under results/; per-run transcripts (runs/) contain local paths and are not published.
